profile.belief: I’ve always been obsessed with how entertainment connects people, it’s a reminder of how refreshing humanity can be when it portrays itself. I always spent my downtime watching pop culture, keeping up with what’s entertaining, the commentary, and fan edits, so diving into this world was natural. Having a strong background in  photography, event management, and editing has connected to so many other people. And I realized I wanted to be a part of that impact, of making people feel.

Representation! Access! 

 I just want people of all kinds to finally see themselves represented in the media and on the screen.  At the end of the day, media is a tool and one of its impacts should build empathy.
